taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: SQS producer/consumer authority and message-driven operations
controls.source_trace: Trace who can send, receive, delete or redrive messages and whether message body/attributes grant downstream authority.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate send, receive, delete and queue-policy administration. Message attributes are producer-controlled unless another verified envelope binds them. Inspect visibility timeout and redelivery as normal delivery behavior, then check consumer idempotency/authority at the final action. Receiving a test message proves read access only to the tested queue and principal.
controls.operational_method: For SNS/EventBridge/service-to-queue delivery, inspect the queue resource-policy principal and applicable aws:SourceArn/aws:SourceAccount constraints. Match the exact source rather than accepting a payload source label. If SSE-KMS applies, keep KMS denial distinct from queue policy denial. The local fixture should model queue admission before consumer processing and use one source-allowed and one source-mismatched marker; no receive/list access to unrelated queues is needed.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a small owned queue or local consumer with synthetic messages; compare rightful producer processing and an untrusted actor/authority field.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A visible queue URL is not queue access; authorized message submission alone is not application privilege escalation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain queue operations and independently validate the consumer action/resource policy, including redrive.
